notes.title: v.263 - Carcion Octo Fest Update Preview
notes.notes:
[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/scpjhiim/wgc-2375-250826-v263-update-logo-and-key-art.gif"]

The Carcion Octo Fest is setting sail towards Maple World and it’s up to us to figure out what’s going on at the shores of Sunset Beach. While we got the octopuses roaming free, there's a new darkness within Tallahart, and his name is Baldrix! Need a little push for the battle? Activate the HEXA Stat III to increase your power! Before we get to that, let’s make sure you are accustomed to our new UI Improvements, since there are many new changes that make navigating through MapleStory even more efficient. But ARRRright mateys, enough yapping! Let's get straight to some of the treasures of the v.263 update.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/2a821f09a4af3dd7be51130fcc2d5efa7837d1ca.png"]


The apostle, Baldrix, makes his appearance in front of the Adversary to overthrow Tallahart! Are you ready to take him on and unleash your wrath?!

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/3jrhnfrj/skeleton-animation_274.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/0c38d0c17118f32839dc8d2c772dad47a241d7b2.png"]



Shiver me timbers, Maplers! We have an urgent call from Captain Kyrin! The Carcion Octo Fest is setting sail straight to Sunset Beach in Carcion, and it looks like they brought a few octopus friends… Gather ‘round and pre-game at the Daily Fest Prep and Weekly Fest Prep for some extra loot before you hit up the Great Octopus Buffet for the real feast! Make sure to collect all your Fatty and Tender Octopuses so you can grub on the Tangyoon or the Ano Dishes! Arrr ya’ feelin’ quite full? Burn off those calories by participating in the Octo Hunt and earn additional rewards! Now let’s set sail! We don’t want you walkin’ the plank now, do we?

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ppjopaly/octo-fest-ui.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/414efd58ff92d52d19025b9bf13872d73ff03220.png"]

 

Along with all the fun in-game events for v.263, we're also revamping the UI in-game with tons of sleek new changes! Get ready to glide through menus and navigate with more ease and efficiency. We'll see UI changes ranging from Main Menus, Equipment Inventories, and Tooltip Revamps! Stay tuned for our upcoming Patch Notes as we will reveal more.

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/iqyebcto/maplestorya_nxl9dfgerk.gif"] 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/b2faa53c81740b8f215315f7d46cd92d22ee0767.png"] 

It’s time to bring out the big guns as the 3rd HEXA Stat can now be activated! If your HEXA Stat I and II are both enhanced to Lv. 20, then you can activate HEXA Stat III for even more massive gains. Better start saving up your Sol Erda and Sol Erda Frags!

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/dcxccn5k/maplestorya_4l7sgexzg1.gif"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/1c667ff877b3f97b9cef6f0da623e9a0d9e871f6.png"]

Oooh~ Do you feel like something is watching you...? I don’t feel so good... If you have the guts, join us and help solve the mysteries of the Haunted Mansion to get to the bottom of this! Work your way through 9 floors of eerie distortions and you can earn some ghostly prizes.

 [img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/llbhqkip/maplestorya_xfmgqzujep.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/2e6ab644cd772d14c16617996f15a881240f48b8.png"]

 

3...2...1! HAPPY NEW - oh! Not that kind of countdown... We are heading to the cold season so let's bundle up and get cozy for the Winter Countdown! Check in during this event period and you can easily stock up on some heated rewards.

 [img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/zwfovurl/winter-countdown.png"] 

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/0qmpulbw/button_forums.png"]            [img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/ssnnkg11/button_discord.png"]


[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/whllj3np/bottom.gif"]

notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/97f2f50b17ec0e89a853de621e1aa42f180da760.jpg"]Spend a night in the town of Sages! The Night Troupe is bringing a festival of dreams and illusions to Mu Lung. Plus, get ready to dive into the new Legion Champion system, where teamwork makes the dream work, and join the Champion Raid to hunt in new territories on Draco Isle. Not only that, Champion Burning is back to help you get ahead of the game! We’ll also be merging NA Interactive Worlds to create a more vibrant and connected experience for you to enjoy.

The Night Troupe is making their way to Mu Lung, where you can be a full-fledged Festival Designer and turn this festival into a colorful and unforgettable experience! Decorate the festival grounds with Festival Decorating and Designer Rank to unlock special skills and progression perks. You can also earn rewards and progress faster with the Night Troupe Sage Ticket or receive buffs by lighting the Lanterns Bright with Wishes!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/07c4e1499bf156c8b290b2dc16d1982e0746b874.png"]

[img src="//g.nexonstatic.com/media/qc3lfu0t/header-champraid.png"]Gather your Legion Champion team because a new territory has arrived, Draco Isle! During your battles, your Bond Meter with your Legion Champion team will fill as you fight for a Final Damage increase, making that last blow super effective!

Keep grinding and you can earn Double Up Coins and rack up various items within the Double Up Coin Shop.

notes.title: [Update July 22] Ride or Die Returns!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/267bceb59cbddfc022d0584e6b42d5e10ef29928.png"]

\[Updated July 22] Note: The final score and participation count for Week 1 will be calculated from July 16 (after maintenance) - July 22 at 11:59 PM UTC.

Kazax has returned to MapleStory with new powers, and Inspector Libae is enlisting your help in battling against this even greater threat! Call upon Althea in battle, harness the power of the Mapae, and earn prizes with each week's boss battle! Take on Kazan himself as the battlefield heats up. Don't forget the new Rank X challenge to test your prowess!

Event Duration:

PDT (UTC -7): Wednesday, July 16, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Tuesday, August 26, 2025 4:59 PM

CEST (UTC +2): Wednesday, July 16, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, August 27, 2025 1:59 AM

AEST (UTC +10): Wednesday, July 16, 2025 (End of Maintenance) - Wednesday, August 27, 2025 9:59 AM
Ride or Die
Quick Overview

Take on up to 5 bosses each week by choosing your difficulty level and setting challenges.

Requirement: Lv. 200 and above (Zero characters that completed Story Quest Act 2).

The higher the difficulty and number of challenges, the greater the rewards will be and a higher final score you'll receive!

Earn rewards like Inspector Coins, Kazax’s Energy Fragments, and weekly Inspector Supply Boxes based on your final score.

How to Participate

Select ‘Ride or Die’ from the Event List and click ‘Participate’ to start the Ride or Die event.

Upon accepting the quest, you’ll be teleported to the event map, where you’ll meet Libae, a new inspector who urgently needs your help to save Maple World!

Setting Boss Difficulty and Challenges

Face off against up to 5 bosses per week by choosing your difficulty and how many challenges you want to take on. The 5 bosses you can challenge are:

Papulatus

Vellum

Horntail

Darknell

Magnus

There are four difficulties to choose from:

Code B: Easy

Code A: Normal

Code S: Hard

Code X: Extreme

Code X Requirements: Only your weapon, secondary weapon, and emblem can be equipped for this challenge. Swapping equipment will be disabled during battle.

Test your strength and limits in Code X to earn the highest reward box and a large number of Kazax fragments! With different bosses and fewer challenges this time, Code X is the perfect chance to push for a high score.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/05ca96d5ad560acb318a1f67835903343a30b342.png"]

Ready for a challenge? You can set up to 15 challenges and one will be randomly assigned to you during each run. The following challenges are available:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/b52a8f4396824dcafd92b9476e4bc11112b44a30.png"]

The score multiplier for challenges have been increased, so the more challenges you take on, the higher your weekly score will be!

You have a total of 20 lives shared across all 5 bosses per week. If you lose them all, you’re done for the week!

Use Practice Mode to familiarize yourself with the bosses! Speak with Libae to adjust the difficulty level and challenges as needed.

Practice Mode is unavailable for Code X difficulty.

An Investigation Result summary will appear when you successfully defeat a boss, showing your current Investigation Score and Weekly Score. Scores are calculated based on:

Chosen difficulty

Number of challenges set

Death count

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/6ce2f6ef14693e8e7388777f05a26395e13b6f41.png"]

Althea's Support

Althea is here to support you during fights! Once inside the boss map, you’ll receive Althea’s Support, a special skill that charges support up to Lv. 3 as you fight.

Charge the skill by collecting support! The more support you receive, the more powerful Althea’s Support skill effect will be!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/be38044964187919cfccaf82c41c892ef1123388.png"]

The amount of support required to charge each level is 150.

For every 15 support gained, one skill gauge slot fills.

Receive a small amount of support at regular intervals.

Receive a great amount of support when your character touches a summoned object.

The object spawns at a random location every 30 seconds and disappears after a certain amount of time.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/5098ad28dab86395dcab90d2c039b64552289182.png"]

Once the gauge is full, press the Interact key to activate one of Althea’s support skills at random. These help clear summoned enemies and disrupt Kazax’s interference.

Right-click the skill icon to toggle between automatic or manual activation.

Kazax's Interference

Kaxaz isn’t going to fight fair, so stay sharp! He’ll appear alongside bosses and randomly uses skills that interfere with your fight.

Weekly Total Score Rewards

Defeat bosses to also earn usable items and Silver, Bronze, or Gold Inspector Coins which can be spent at the Coin Shop for exclusive rewards!

Each week after the event reset, you'll receive a Weekly Total Score which will determine:

Which Inspector's Supply Box you receive

How many Kazax's Energy Fragments you earn

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/957c1d5fb88a3a3b308c3a3774e40eaaa1b5431c.png"]

There are six levels of Inspector’s Supply Boxes that can be obtained. Score higher to receive higher-level boxes.

You can only claim 1 box a week per account. Rewards can only be claimed after the event weekly reset.

Rewards for Week 6 can be claimed immediately after completing that week's challenge.

[Updated 7:27 PM PDT] The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 15 hours. Please restart your Nexon Launcher or Steam to make sure that you get the latest client! 

We have also provided compensation which can be claimed through the Gift Drop function on the left side of the screen once you login.
Players are able to claim the compensation after the maintenance until July 30th at 11:59 PM UTC.Compensation included the following items:[table][tr][th]Item[/th][th]Amount[/th][th]Tradability and Duration[/th][/tr][tr][td]Magnificent Growth Potion[/td][td]1[/td][td]Tradable within world, 7-day duration[/td][/tr][tr][td]VIP Booster[/td][td]10[/td][td]Tradable within world, 7-day duration[/td][/tr][tr][td]4x EXP Coupon[/td][td]5[/td][td]Tradable within world, 7-day duration[/td][/tr][tr][td]Sol Erda/Fragment Selector Coupon (1/30)[/td][td]2[/td][td]Tradable within world, 7-day duration[/td][/tr][tr][td]Symbol Selector Coupon (20/4)[/td][td]1[/td][td]Tradable within world, 7-day duration[/td][/tr][/table]

[Updated 6:55 PM PDT] We are currently going through the final tests on the live server and will open as soon as all checks have been completed!
We thank you for being patient during this time and will provide further updates when we can.

[Updated 5:25 PM PDT] Maintenance extension is due to an unexpected issue that was found while testing the Ride or Die event that is taking longer than initially anticipated. We once again apologize for the extended delay and will update this post when additional information is received. We sincerely thank you for your patience regarding this matter.

[Updated 1:35 PM PDT] We will be extending maintenance until further notice. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this may have caused you and thank you for your patience!

We will be performing a scheduled game update starting on Wednesday, July 16, 2025 at 5:00 AM PDT (8:00 AM EDT / 2:00 PM CEST / 10:00 PM AEST). We anticipate the maintenance to conclude around 2:00 PM PDT (5:00 PM EDT / 11:00 PM CEST / 7:00 AM AEST July 17).

Get ready to Wish Upon a Shooting Star, because Sia Astelle has descended from the mystical land of Oort! notes.title: Important Changes Coming in v.260
notes.notes:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2098/120516_1100x225_generic_news_6410.jpg

Hi Maplers,

We will be implementing changes to certain in-game features and would like to provide some information for what you can expect from these changes:
Removal and Refunds of Custom TitlesWith the system revamp of the Medal and Title feature, Custom Titles and Medal Fusion Anvils will be removed from the Cash Shop and in-game.Due to this we will be providing refunds to players who currently have a Custom Title Coupon obtained from the recent sale of Easter Baskets. The refund amount will be based on the Easter Basket the item was obtained from:Large Mysterious Easter Basket: 3,000 Maple PointsSmall Mysterious Easter Basket: 1,000 Maple PointsRefunds will be processed in 2 waves:Wave 1: During the maintenance on June 11, 2025.Wave 2: During a future maintenance in August 2025.More details to follow in the future.Please note the following:Custom Titles will not function after the v.260 game update and we ask to refrain from using the Custom Title Coupon after the update.If you used a Custom Title Coupon to receive a Custom Title, you are eligible for refund in August.If you have a Medal Fusion Anvil Coupon or Medal Fusion Anvil, they will retain their functionality and still can be used.Removal of Teleport Rocks from the Cash ShopAs part of a revamp to the way players navigate around the game, will be ending the sale of Teleport Rocks, Hyper Teleport Rocks, and VIP Teleport Rocks through the Cash Shop starting after the maintenance on June 11, 2025. Players who currently have Teleport Rocks of any kind, including permanent ones, will still be able to use them alongside the revamp after the maintenance. Their functionality will remain unchanged from before the v.260 game update.New Style Box Stamp ShopWe will be introducing a new type of Style Box Stamp, along with its very own Style Box Stamp Shop that you can look forward to in the Stargazer update.Without spoiling any surprises, this upcoming change will affect the way Surprise Style Box items can be exchanged for stamps. So please carefully observe the details below:Items obtained from Surprise Style Boxes AFTER June 25, 2025 at 8:00 AM UTC can ONLY be exchanged for stamps that will be used in the new Style Box Stamp Shop.Items obtained from Surprise Style Boxes BEFORE June 25, 2025 at 8:00 AM UTC can ONLY be exchanged for stamps in the current Style Box Stamp Shop.The existing Style Box Stamp Shop through NPC Shiro will remain accessible for any players who own existing Style Box Stamps.The items that can be purchased from the existing Style Box Stamp Shop will be updated after June 25, 2025 8:00 AM UTC.DirectX 11 SupportWe will be introducing DirectX 11 support to provide a more enjoyable gaming experience. As such, DirectX 9 support will be discontinued from this point onward. We ask that you update to DirectX 11.0 or higher to ensure your game runs smoothly as support for DirectX 9 will end after the game update.Troubleshooting - If the game doesn’t launch or you see a DirectX-related error after the update, we recommend checking your system’s DirectX version and updating if needed.To download and update DirectX to the latest version, click HERE.
We hope that everyone will be able to enjoy these changes along with the many others coming in the next Stargazer update. We thank you for your understanding and continued support!

~The MapleStory Team

notes.title: MapleStory's 20th Anniversary Update is Live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/c6df0c3b6c48d7556e2efc9e27575e80c84bbfb6.png

On May 11, 2005, MapleStory made its debut in North America, and in the 20 years that has come since, it's been our pleasure to watch you enjoy every moment of fun that has come in Maple World. We're celebrating these two decades with a special new update, featuring a new job to play, an exciting sports day event, and a special look at things to come!

Now Available: Mo Xuan!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/4235849a31ffeffc0f4a54a1555b2148c3c6e09b.png

A mighty new warrior has come to MapleStory, a talented martial artist with a power that's been passed down throughout the ages. Play as Mo Xuan, the Divine Fist, MapleStory's newest character and claim your rewards in the Xiao Xiao's Level-Up Support Event!

You can learn more about Mo Xuan, and find out what you can earn by leveling him up, on the official MapleStory website!

Victoria Cup Event
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/10352a63bbe99f431c76a72af544eae3ece2f82e.png

The biggest Sports Day that Victoria Island has ever seen is here! Take on challenging sporting events such as Victoria Soccer, Boat Racing, Balloon Pop Challenge and much more to bring home trophies, unique outfits, and other amazing rewards!

20th Anniversary Patch Notes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/85e287c430194d5f892849afbcdcf1ffc50f6652.jpg

Learn everything about MapleStory's 20th Anniversary update, including the full details on the Victoria Cup, the newly added Grandis Familiars, a more convenient way to jump between characters on the same world, and more in the patch notes on the official MapleStory website!

Read the latest Inkwell's Note!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/0bf64ab1e82074b60ef490e5162dad056b986da4.png

Inkwell, MapleStory's Chief Product Officer, also recently penned a note to the MapleStory community, talking about the 20th anniversary, the last few months of updates, as well as a preview of all the changes and improvements we're looking to add to MapleStory soon. You can read it in full on the official MapleStory website!

We'll catch ya'll at the Main Stadium!

notes.title: Upcoming Marvel Machine Changes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/b0ac322d3c7c6ed91028e9319c089b8412f63e65.jpg

A pair of changes are coming to the Marvel Machine that will take effect with its next run, currently planned for late summer 2025. These changes are:
Newly purchased Marvels can be used up to 90 days after the end of the event, and will expire after that point.Item codes obtained from used Marvels will remain available to be redeemed in-game for 1 year after being acquired from the Marvel Machine.
Maplers with remaining Marvels purchased from previous runs of the event will still be able to use them during future Marvel Machine runs and they will not expire. Those pre-existing Marvels will be expended before any newly purchased Marvels are used.

Thank you,

-The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Steam Community Market (Beta) Issue Update
notes.notes:
Hi Maplers,

We’re excited to see everyone’s interest in the launch of the Steam Community Market (Beta) feature! However, we’re aware that a small number of players experienced an issue where their items disappeared when attempting to register them to the Steam Inventory UI.

As we continue to improve and refine this Beta feature, we’ve identified the cause and are working on a fix scheduled for next week’s maintenance.

To prevent further issues, we're temporarily disabling the ability to register items to the Steam Inventory UI and the sale of Oswell's Scissors of Karma today, at 2:00 PM PDT (5:00 PM EDT / 10:00 PM CET / 8:00 AM AEDT March 22), until the fix is in place. Please note that any items already in your Steam Inventory will continue to function normally on the Steam Community Market and can be retrieved as usual.

For players who were affected, any lost items will be returned once the issue is resolved.

We appreciate your patience and sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

Thank you,

The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Concerning the Release of Update v.255
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952675/a6b70cd8537f64c26cd06e6c19665d2b6c35b809.jpg

Hello, Maplers.

First, we'd like to apologize for the unexpected issues and gameplay disruptions that occurred when the v.255 update went live. We understand the severity of this situation, and will learn from it to improve our processes. We remain committed to supporting a stable and high quality play experience.

Below, we will outline the primary issues that occurred with the v.255 update and summarize the current state of affairs.

1. Extended Maintenance

There were several issues pertaining to new content and system updates. The main issues were as follows:
Extended maintenance on the day of the v.255 update: Parts of the game that worked as intended during internal testing suddenly became unplayable when running on live servers. The maintenance was extended beyond what was initially estimated to investigate, fix, and retest these issues.Crashes and additional maintenance: There were several crashes after the v.255 update went live:Server crashes when generating certain rewards upon defeating an enemy. Due to the frequency of the crashes, a maintenance was required to implement a quick fix.Server crashes when the Guardian Angel Slime would finish a boss pattern and then vanish.Client crashes when Shade used Soul Splitter while fighting Ursus.Aside from crashes, there was also an issue where a long quest was being finished quickly due to Black Mage Remnants erroneously remaining on a drop table. Separately, many rare boss rewards that should not have been affected by the drop rate increase were affected. Given the effect these issues would have on game balance and fairness to our players, it was clear we needed to take urgent action.Aside from the issues noted above, there was also an additional maintenance done to address the unintended functionality of the Frenzy Totem, rewards not being generated when Zero characters defeated a boss, and other issues with the new Ride or Die content.
2. Content Issues
Removal of certain Page of Memories mini-games:During internal testing, we discovered that the Spirit's Memories and Spirit's Emotions mini-games were causing extreme lag in most Global MapleStory service regions. The lag was severe enough that normal gameplay was being adversely affected. In these mini-games, a new sync method called "Lockstep" was used. However, this method was not well-suited to some environments with the network ping conditions of regions where Global MapleStory is serviced. Considering the limited time the live service team had to address the issue, the decision was eventually made to remove the affected mini-games for the sake of stability. To compensate, the EXP Vouchers that would have been granted by these mini-games were instead added to the Ride or Die Inspector Boxes. However, we overlooked the fact that the Ride or Die reward is given a week after the patch, and that players weren't made aware of that fact. We apologize for the confusion this has caused, and will strive to be more clear in the future.Please be aware that EXP Vouchers will also be obtainable from the Burning Express event and Dark Maplemas mini-game in the v.256 update.Changes to the Intense Power Crystal:A change was made to the number of Intense Power Crystals that can be sold each week. However, the proper price adjustments were not made, causing a dip in some players' meso earnings.We are actively considering additional changes that will be applied during maintenance on Dec. 5, 2024. We apologize for the delay in confirming these changes.Other Issues:We are aware that there are other issues not listed here. We will do our best to fix as many as we can in the upcoming maintenance on Dec. 5, 2024.
To apologize for any inconvenience you may have experienced, we've prepared the following compensation package for you.

Server Maintenance Compensation
Claim Period: Wednesday, November 27, 2024 1:25 AM UTC- Tuesday, December 10, 2024 11:59 PM UTCHow to Claim: Talk to the Maple Administrator NPC in the Event Hall map, and select Server Maintenance Compensation to claim. (Limit once per account.)Package Contents:[table][tr][th]Item[/th][th]Count[/th][th]Duration (Days)[/th][th]Tradability[/th][/tr][tr][td]3x EXP Coupon (15 min)[/td][td]x15[/td][td]7[/td][td]Untradable[/td][/tr][tr][td]Special Medal of Honor[/td][td]x10[/td][td]7[/td][td]Untradable[/td][/tr][tr][td]Symbol Selector Coupons. Select one of the below:Arcane Symbol Selector Coupon (100)Sacred Symbol Selector Coupon (25)[/td][td]x1[/td][td]7[/td][td]Tradable within Account[/td][/tr][tr][td]Trait Boost Potion[/td][td]x3[/td][td]7[/td][td]Untradable[/td][/tr][tr][td]Extreme Growth Potion[/td][td]x5[/td][td]7[/td][td]Untradable[/td][/tr][tr][td]Growth Potion Selector Coupon. Select one of the below:Growth Potion (200 - 209) (8)Growth Potion (200 - 219) (4)Growth Potion (200 - 229) (2)Typhoon Growth Potion (1)[/td][td]x1[/td][td]7[/td][td]Tradable within Account[/td][/tr][tr][td]Karma Black Rebirth Flame[/td][td]x5[/td][td]7[/td][td]Tradable within Account[/td][/tr][tr][td]Experience Nodestone[/td][td]x2[/td][td]7[/td][td]Tradable within Account[/td][/tr][tr][td]VIP Buff Selector Coupon[/td][td]x3[/td][td]7[/td][td]Tradable within Account[/td][/tr][/table]
We know many of you were excited for this update, and we apologize once again for failing to meet your expectations. We will redouble our efforts to prepare and review our work so we can provide better service in the future. Thank you for your understanding.

Thank you,

The MapleStory Team

What will be unavailable:All MapleStory game servers.Changes and updates:MapleStory will be updated to v.255.2.0.The following content regarding the Frenzy Totem has been changed:Resolved an issue where the Frenzy Totem and Chains of Resentment mob respawn speed was not applied as intended.Resolved an issue where Frenzy Totem was not able to be cast again in a a map where a Frenzy Totem was used.[Dev Comment] The new Chains of Resentment totem was designed based on the previous Frenzy Totem, but we have confirmed that stats related to mob regen speed wasn't applied as intended. This has caused the overall mob regen speed to drop compared to before, and we apologize for the inconvenience we have caused the players. As notified before, the dev team's intent was to keep the previous Frenzy Totem's mob regen speed and mob regen quantities, and this will apply in the same way to the new Chains of Resentment totems. The Chains of Resentment differs from the Frenzy Totems in whether the effect remains on the map when the caster moves maps, and the effects of the Chains of Resentment disappears when the caster moves maps. In order to prevent disrupting another player on a map where the Chains of Resentment have already been used due to this differentiation, the Chains of Resentment can't be used again on a map where the effect has already been applied. The Frenzy Totem being able to be used on the same map again was an intended mechanic, and any unintended changes after the v255 patch will be fixed with this maintenance, and please understand that the previous specs weren't intended.The Ride or Die Horntail HP has been adjusted.[Dev Comment] The intent behind Ride or Die is to allow characters to defeat bosses based on their strength and earn rewards, thus motivating players to become stronger. This event has 6 types of bosses, and for the Horntail, we have confirmed that its HP is much lower than we first intended. This has allowed players to defeat the Horntail much more easily in Code S difficulty, resulting in an experience different from what we intended. Thus the dev team has decided to increase the Horntail's HP to provide a difficulty level more appropriate to the intended strength of the character. We apologize for the inconvenience for the Ride or Die event.Resolved an issue where the Genesis Crux would drop multiple Black Mage Remnants.Resolved an issue where Absolute Zero Aura: Vortex would crash other players on the map when the skill ends.Resolved an issue where the achievenment '[From Memory] The One Who's Touched the Sky of the Grand Athenaeum' was not obtainable.Resolved an issue where Exceptional Hammers were not displayed as rewards for Extreme Kaling and Kalos.Resolved an issue where both old enhancement and exceptional hammer still drop from the extreme bosses (Kaling, Black Mage, Seren, Kalos).Resolved an issue where summoned familiars did not contribute towards total combat power.Resolved an issue where weekly participation for Ride or Die rewards did not have the correct duration listed.Resolved an issue where players would fall through platforms when fighting Guardian Angel Slime.Resolved an issue where certain characters were unable to join Item Burning.Resolved an issue where the text was cut off when speaking to Thales.Resolved an issue where the character deletion UI displayed incorrect text.Resolved an issue where Flushed Toothy Smirk Coupon and Blushing Toothy Smirk Coupon are unable to be claimed from The Dark Ride ticket.Resolved an issue where Damage Skin Slot Expansion Coupon's text had "C's" appearing in the description.Resolved an issue where the Papulatus Items were not dropping in Practice Mode for Ride or Die.Resolved an issue where players were unable to use buff skills and Atmospheric Effects in the 'In Front of the Temple' map. Resolved an issue where incorrect items would display in the Maple Planner.

notes.title: v.254 - Midnight Carnival - Ludibrium Update Preview
notes.notes:

BOO! Our Night Troupe is making its daring return just in time for the mischievous season of Halloween! We have lots in store to really get this season going! You can start with earning bonus stats by leveling up your Festival Designer Rank in Ludibrium or you can kick back and put together some solid fits through our Maple Fashion Week. We’ve been to Henesys, Rien, Nautilus... and now, it’s time to explore the castle of toys! The Night Troupe is back and this time, they’re taking us to Ludibrium!
        
Level up your Festival Designer Rank to unlock bonus stats, and power up even more with Festival Decorating perks that give your character (and boss mules) extra gains! notes.title: Minimum System Requirements Update in Early October
notes.notes:
//g.nexonstatic.com/media/hrdn1yrd/120516_1100x225_generic_news_6410.jpg

Attention Maplers,

In order to maintain the security and stability of MapleStory, we will be updating the Minimum System Requirements for MapleStory in an update scheduled for early October. Starting from that update, MapleStory will no longer be supporting operating systems below Windows 10. If you are using Windows 8.1 or below, you will be able to resume normal play after upgrading to Windows 10 or higher. For more information on upgrading Windows, please visit the Microsoft website.

Thank you for your cooperation,

The MapleStory Team

notes.title: v.250 - Mayple Island Update Preview
notes.notes:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1248/header.png

Happy 19th anniversary, MapleStory! Explore the numerous events, mini-games, and shops filled with one-of-a-kind goodies at Mayple Island. Experience the adorable new class, Forest Child Lynn, and her versatile kit that will be influential in any party environment. Play through the newly revamped [Hieizan] Theme Dungeon with quality of life and balance improvements. Organize your outfits and decorate all your characters with the return of the Cash Shop Transfer event. Create a Zero character at any time of the year now that Zero creation is no longer limited to specific seasons!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1250/mayple-island.png

The fairies of Mayple Island have prepared so many events for you in celebration of the 19th anniversary of Global MapleStory! Participating in challenges every day will fill up the Mayple Wish Orb with wishes which will reward you with items, such as Growth Potions and 3x EXP Coupons. There will be three currencies you can use to redeem for items, Mayple Leaves, Mayple Candies, and Mayple Stars that you can earn from participating in daily events and mini-games. Additionally, the Mayple Island event map has numerous interactive areas where you can take pictures with your friends, so try sitting on various parts of the island (our favorite is the Merry-Go-Round). We can’t wait for you to enjoy the beautiful Mayple Island!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1249/mayple-island-ss.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1246/child-of-the-forest-lynn.png

Forest Child Lynn is our newest class who uses the power of the forest to help Maplers defeat their enemies! Her Spirit Guides, Pan, Penni, and Paeon provide her with extra damage and each have special skills that can be helpful in any situation. Lynn has a few mobility skills including ‘Light Leap’ (flash jump) and ‘[Focus] Support Flight’ which instantly transports herself to a target and vice versa. Additionally, her kit is quite versatile containing multiple healing skills and even having a skill that increases item drop rate for herself! Lynn will always be available for creation but we will have special durational rewards at launch, so we highly recommend creating her upon release!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1247/forest-child-lynn-ss.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1240/hieizan-theme-dungeon-revamp.png

We’ve revamped the [Hieizan] Theme Dungeon so farming ‘Kanna’s Treasure’ every week will be more efficient! First and foremost, you will no longer teleport when attacking Mikagami, but rather only when you are attacked. In addition, the number of hits required to defeat Mikagami has been decreased. We’ve also made adjustments to the skills of Oura Shogun, Miroku, and Princess No to improve the overall balance of the dungeon.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1239/hieizan-theme-dungeon-revamp-ss.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1245/cash-shop-transfer.png

The Cash Shop Transfer event has returned! For one week, you’ll be able to transfer Cash Shop items from a character to any other character of your choice within the same world. If you’re transferring to the same class, you’ll transfer through the Cash Inventory as usual without using the special new Cash Transfer button.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1244/cash-shop-transfer-ss.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1252/zero-creation.png

Currently, Zero can only be created during specific seasons but starting from the v.250 update, Zero will be available for creation at all times! Please note that in order to create a Zero, you must already have an existing Lv. 100 character.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q2/1251/zero-creation-ss.png

notes.title: Maple Memo: Font Change Update
notes.notes:
http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2018/5580/181107mm1100ip.jpg

Hi Maplers,

After the v.249 update, you may have seen that the in-game font for multiple menus and titles was adjusted. We'd like to inform you that the font will be reverted back to the original style in the v.250 update and share with you why these changes were made.

While testing the new Character Info UI, we were finding that certain text and letters were not being properly aligned. To address the issue, the original font was modified to increase legibility which impacted all UI elements. We will be reverting this and only applying the legibility changes to the Character Info UI.
Additionally, specific letters such as "w", "v", "t" and "f" can be hard to distinguish when they are typed next to each other. Therefore, we applied a change that added more spacing between these characters. This change will also be reverted to the original spacing. 

Although we are reverting the font back to the original style, we will continue to focus on improving our players' day-to-day gameplay experience. As always, your feedback is immensely important to us and we appreciate your support.

Thank you,

Mjollnir

Upgrade your monster farm and show them more love with improvements to Monster Life. Last but certainly not least, check out the Better Maple improvements!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2414/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_02.png

Did you pack your picnic mat and snacks? Chief Tatamo is inviting you to the Minar Picnic where you can join the Halflingers for some wholesome fun! But you’ll need to fight off the monsters who are attempting to ruin your picnic and defend your new friends. To thank you for fighting them off, Chino will reward you with an abundance of gifts, such as a Minar Picnic Box and Magnificent Growth Potion!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2409/minar-picnic-sc-1.png

To thank you for defending them, the Halflingers would like to reward you with a treasure hunt!  Assemble special lunches for the Halflingers and send them out to various locations where they’ll bring back goodies to help you progress. These Halflingers have prepared so many events for you so be sure to treat them well!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2410/minar-picnic-1-sc2.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2401/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_04.png

Take a break from grinding and visit the Grand Athenaeum to read about the history of MapleStory! Learn about the riveting backstory of Carcion, the Cradle of Life which has been added to the Book of Grandis and experience the art that is Grand Athenaeum Episode 7: Sefirot’s Gardener.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2411/grand-athenaeum-sc.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2402/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_06.png

It’s harvesting season! The Profession revamp will allow you to craft and farm faster than ever before. The crafting cooldown time has been removed for all items! You can now learn Accessory Crafting, Smithing, and Alchemy at the same time in Interactive Worlds. Ardentmill’s harvesting maps are now instanced so you no longer need to be changing channels constantly to collect the items you need. We’ve also increased the maximum Fatigue which will allow players to harvest for double the amount of time than before. Additionally, Accessory Crafting, Equipment Crafting, and Alchemy’s mastery will no longer decrease! 

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2388/alchemy-ui.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2403/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_09.png

Want to know how you’re progressing? The Character UI is reorganized to better display information so it’s easier to see your performance. We’re adding new information, such as Combat Power, Normal Enemy Damage, and Cooldown Reduction, so you have a better idea of how you’ll measure up in different areas. You’ll also be able to see more information about other players, such as their Arcane Symbols, applied Link Skills, and Hexa Matrix. Better get on those dailies… 

Also, we know how much you love customization so we are adding backgrounds to your character’s avatar area. Now you can show off your outfit with a little more pizazz. Another element added for your fashionstory!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2390/character-ui-sc.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2404/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_11.png

Monster Life will be improved so you can take better care of your farm! We’re increasing the chance of receiving a Special Category monster when combining monsters. The maximum storage capacity of buildings will be increased by 400% so you can store 4x as much Waru than before and auto-collect all the Waru from all the buildings at once! You can then use that Waru to extend the lifespan of certain ranked monsters. With these improvements, your monsters will be much happier than before!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2415/monster-life-sc-1.png

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2024/q1/2405/wgc-753-240200-v249-minar-picnic-key-art-logo-small_13.png

What better way to improve your daily gameplay than with quality of life updates? Since you’re always grinding for Sol Erda Energy and Sol Erda Fragments, you can now assign the Sol Erda UI to a shortcut so it can be more easily accessed. If you have the Sol Erda UI activated, it will be active even after logging off! Now the moment you’ve been waiting for…certain consumables, such as Power Elixirs and Mystical Cubes, are now stackable up to x9999 per inventory slot they occupy! Hurray to inventory management!

notes.title: Maple Memo: v.246 New Age Update Clarification
notes.notes:
http://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2018/5580/181107mm1100ip.jpg

Hi Maplers,

We understand that there are a lot of concerns about information that was recently revealed regarding the v.246 New Age: 6th Job update. First, we would like to truly apologize for causing concern due to the lack of prior information regarding New Age’s 6th Job content. We would like to clarify the development intentions for the parts our Maplers are currently worried about, and share future plans.

6th Job Advancement: Sol Erda
As we prepared the 6th Job Advancement update, our goal was to provide motivations to our players for character growth and enhancement, as well as provide content that players would be able to use actively and flexibly, without being limited to only mobbing. We wanted to consider the appropriate daily material acquisition rate and method, taking into consideration our existing players’ behavior, while also taking into account the difficulty level where newer players wouldn’t feel like it would be too much of a hurdle. We wanted to mitigate the negative aspects to the gameplay experience such as illegal tool usage or paying for services for other players to farm that occurs as a result of having an acquisition method that was mainly focused on mobbing.

With these goals in mind, we wished to lower the burden that our players might feel regarding play time and increase the accessibility for casual players by distributing the Sol Erda Energy and the Sol Erda Fragments through the Daily Quest. Additionally, we added the daily cap because we wished to narrow the gap that depended on playtime between the hardcore players and those who could not dedicate as much time to the game. We were planning to monitor the actual acquisition time of our players, the play time, and adjust the cap as needed. We understand that seeing changes like this being shown in gameplay videos and streams without detailed context from our team has caused a lot of anger and frustration with you all. We would like to apologize to our Maplers once again, since the design intention for this part has not been explained enough in advance. Regardless of the design intentions, we understand that there are many aspects to these changes that you are understandably concerned about, so in addition to the Daily Quest that will remain, we will remove the cap and explore separate improvement measures for parts that could be harmful for the gameplay experience.

Also, we would like to share that we have no plans to release the Sol Erda Booster at the same time as the 6th Job Advancement update. We will review the progress of our players’ 6th Job Advancement and determine if and when there is a need to further augment the ways in which players can obtain Sol Erda.

Frenzy Totem
We would like to confirm that - contrary to some information being circulated in the community - Frenzy Totems were always planned to function as they normally do outside of instanced maps and that is intended to remain the same in the New Age update. There was a bug in our test server regarding this functionality and we did not properly address this situation before the information was discovered and spread within the community. As mentioned in the v.246 patch notes released yesterday, the instanced maps are provided during the New Age patch duration for the Sacred Power fields, and the way the Frenzy Totem works in these instanced fields are as follows:
Frenzy Totem effects will only apply to the hunting map of the character that used the Frenzy Totem. The effect will disappear once the character leaves the instanced map.
We understand that this kind of communication should have come out sooner and the context for why we made these changes should have been delivered at the same time we announced them. We hope that this memo can, at the very least, give you insight into how we implement design changes to our service.

Sincerely,

Mjollnir and the MapleStory Team

notes.notes:

[Update Oct 26] We are aware of an issue where some of the World's Best Punch King winners have received incorrect in-game rewards for their placement in the Top 10 Rankings. For those that were affected, please go ahead and claim the rewards, even if they are incorrect, by October 31, 2023 11:59 PM UTC, and we will swap it out for the correct reward during the an upcoming scheduled maintenance. The World’s Best Punch King event has ended and now it’s time for the top-ranked players to receive their rewards! Players who participated in the event had to defeat Punch King monsters and score at least 1,500 points in order to register in the ranking.

Check out the #1 top-ranked Maplers from each job HERE!

Rankings are registered separately for NA and EU worlds, and separately for Reboot and Aurora, Bera, Elysium, Luna, and Scania worlds too. You can also see the top 10 ranked winners from these worlds.

notes.title: v.245 - Midnight Carnival - Nautilus Update Preview
notes.notes:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2514/wgc-195-230922-v245-update-preview_01.png

It’s becoming spooky season in Maple World and the Night Troupe is back to celebrate Halloween! Rank up your Designer Rank by participating in all the festivities and hunting monsters. Festival Decorating will provide new ways to decorate the festival booths as you rise through the ranks, giving you passive buffs. Looking to decorate your home to keep up with the times? The [Home] Halloween event is back with new surprises. Let’s not forget that this update also comes with a Permanent Secondary Pendant Slot for all Maplers! Enjoy your time in Nautilus as you attend the Midnight Carnival!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2541/wgc-195-230922-v245-update-preview_02.png

The Night Troupe festival of dreams and illusions is back for Halloween! As your Designer Rank improves every week, you’ll be able to participate in more and more of the festivities.

Starting the week off as a Junior, you’ll have to decide whether to hunt treasure with Spiegelmann or Kyrin. You’ll get to re-choose which side you’re on every week so don’t think too hard about it! You’ll also get to enjoy a fantastic fireworks show that provides buffs to all every night of the event!

As a Senior you’ll be able to either gain experience over at Spiegelette’s Potion Bar, or traits through Tangyoon’s Crazy Feast. Just sit back and relax as you reap the benefits.

As a Veteran, you’ll get to test your shot at the Lawless Nautilus Shooting Range. Aim wisely, as what you hit will determine your reward!

Win it big on your final week at the Midnight Carnival when you become a Master. On the 4th floor, you will be tasked with finding the real Spiegelmann. Watch out, as two of them are pirates in disguise. You’ll also get the chance to play Shulynch’s Pirate Roulette. Whatever the arrow lands on is your prize!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2516/wgc-195-230922-v245-update-preview_03.png

Querencia is celebrating Halloween once again this year with some new surprises in store. Play through a special story chapter for the Home content to unlock a special Shopping category full of Halloween-themed Furnishings and Blueprints. This time around, you’ll even have the chance to expand your Halloween Manor to a 3-story house. Make sure to check out this limited time event before it’s gone!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2518/wgc-195-230922-v245-update-preview_04.png

Hallowkitty is back and ready to reward Maplers that help her out. By completing a daily mission, you’ll be able to receive one of two Cat Ears, a Halloween Candle Chair, and a Night Cat Damage Skin. There’s even a Hidden Mission and reward for those who seek them out!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2520/wgc-195-230922-v245-update-preview_05.png

The dark magician triplets, Melky, Balther, and Casper, have found another ancient artifact! Get ready to defeat monsters, so you can gather Sweet Snacks. You’ll need these Sweet Snacks to get the mysterious power of the Magic Slate from the triplets. You’ll gain Experience from collecting Sweet Snacks every day and will be rewarded with a Strength Buff that is determined by how many Sweet Snacks you turn in!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2521/wgc-195-230922-v245-update-preview_06.png

The time has come for the Secondary Pendant Slot to be unlocked for all Maplers permanently. With the Permanent Secondary Pendant Slot making its way into the game, you will no longer need coupons to unlock the slot!

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2540/wgc-195-230922-v245-update-preview_07.png

Finally, all those outfits you’ve been hoarded can be transferred to the character of your choice with the Cash Inventory Transfer Event! Make sure you pay attention to the dates listed in the upcoming patch notes and plan accordingly.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q3/2543/wgc-195-230922-v245-update-preview_divider.png

notes.title: Important Changes to Expired Item Pickup
notes.notes:
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2023/q2/2098/120516_1100x225_generic_news_6410.jpg

Attention Maplers,

Currently, loot ownership of items and mesos dropped by monsters defeated by another player would eventually 'expire', making it a free-for-all and allowing other players to pick up the items and mesos. In the v.246 update, loot ownership of items and mesos will be changed to no longer 'expire' and will only be lootable by the player who defeated the monster.

Because of this change, the Expired Pickup Skill for pets will no longer be necessary and therefore will be discontinued from the Cash Shop in the v.245 update. The Expired Pickup Skill for pets will also be removed from the Pet Boost Package sold in the Cash Shop, and the Pet Boost Package's price will be reduced from 7,000 NX to 6,500 NX.

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Important Changes to Second Pendant Slot
notes.notes:
Attention Maplers,

As previously announced, we are making a change in the v.244 update that will allow buffs to remain on a character upon death without the need for Buff Freezers. We’re ecstatic to see the community anticipate this change, as we know it will bring a better Mapling experience to all players. 

In addition to the previous announcement, we’d also like to share our plans to make the second pendant slot permanently available for all characters without the use of a separate item. This change will start in our v.245 update, which is scheduled for October 4, 2023. In preparation for this, we will be discontinuing the sale of the Pendant Slot Coupon (30 day) from the Cash Shop on September 4, 2023. 

We look forward to providing an even better MapleStory experience for players with this change.

notes.title: Important Changes to Buff Freezers
notes.notes:
Attention Maplers,

With the v.244 update, currently scheduled for August 30, we will be making changes to the way buffs interact with character death. Instead of removing any active buffs from characters upon death, characters will now have their buffs persist without the use of a Buff Freezer.

[With this upcoming change, we would like to inform you that Buff Freezers, Cash Shop items which currently protect the player from losing their buffs upon death, will be removed from sale during the Cash Shop Update on August 23, 2023, and any Buff Freezers purchased before the removal date will naturally expire before the v.244 update. In addition to this, Buff Freezers will not appear in the current run of Marvel Machine and any unused Buff Freezer Marvel Machine coupons will be disabled.

We hope that this change to death penalties and Buff Freezers will make for a better MapleStory experience going forward.

notes.title: [Updated] Maple Memo: Update on NA Reboot Server Instability
notes.notes:
Hi Maplers,

We are writing to extend our sincerest apologies for the recent inconvenience caused by the downtime that occurred on July 20, 2023. For approximately 15 minutes, all NA Reboot world channels were inaccessible. On investigation, we found that some players' gameplay records had not been saved due to this server instability. We understand how frustrating and disappointing it can be to experience disruptions in your gameplay, and we take full responsibility for the inconvenience you have endured.

In recognition of these issues, we will be providing all players who have a login record in NA Reboot world anytime between the v.243 game update on July 19th at 12:00 PM UTC, and the time of instability on July 21st at 1:48 AM UTC, the following compensation (once per account):
Compensation Box: Untradable, 7-day duration.
2x EXP Coupon (15 min) (x20): Untradable, 7-day duration.Special Medal of Honor (x5): Untradable, 7-day duration.Symbol Selector Coupon: Tradeable within account, 7-day duration.
Trait Boost Potion: Untradable, 7-day duration.
Extreme Growth Potion: Untradable, 7-day duration.
Growth Potion Selector Coupon: Untradable, 7-day duration.
Nodestones (x25): Untradeable, 7-day duration.
These items will be delivered during the Scheduled Minor Patch on July 27, 2023. Please be sure to claim the items from the in-game Gift Drop menu by August 9th, 2023 at 11:59 PM UTC. We are aware that the in-game item description for the Compensation Box is incorrect, please refer to the list on this post for the correct items.

Separate to the compensation above, if you have experienced a loss in progression or items, please contact our Player Support here, and we request for your patience as we do our best to assist each player as swiftly as possible.

Players who have lost their Hyper Burning Lv. 220 rewards, the selection 17-Star AbsoLab Weapon Box or 15-Star Dominator Pendant Box, will have their rewards redistributed in an upcoming maintenance. If you are one of these players, please contact our Player Support team with the subject line "Hyper Burning Lv. 220 rewards", so we can investigate and ensure you are properly compensated.

We will do our best to prevent similar issues from occurring in the future, as it is our goal to provide a stable game environment for everyone. We greatly appreciate your patience as we investigated this issue, and thank you for being part of the MapleStory community.

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Dormant Guild Removal with v.241 Update
notes.notes:
Attention Maplers,

With the v.241 update, tentatively scheduled for Wednesday, May 3, 2023, we will be cleaning up the guild lists by removing a number of guilds populated entirely by inactive players. At that time, any guild that has not had a single member log into MapleStory since May 2, 2020 will be considered dormant and will be removed.
[table][tr][th]Type[/th][th]Category[/th][th]Deletion?[/th][/tr][tr][td]At least one guild member has logged in since 12:00 AM UTC on May 2, 2020.[/td][td]Active Guild[/td][td]No[/td][/tr][tr][td]No guild members have been recorded as logging in since 12:00 AM UTC on May 2, 2020.[/td][td]Dormant Guild[/td][td]Yes[/td][/tr][/table]
Note: Dormant Guilds that are the Alliance Leaders of a Guild Alliance will not be deleted. For example, if Guild A and Guild B are both in an Alliance, with Guild A as the leader, Guild B will be deleted, but Guild A will be preserved.

If you are a member of one of those guilds and wish to preserve it, all that is required is to log into MapleStory on a character that is part of that guild prior to the v.241 update.

Thank you,

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Upcoming Cube Changes
notes.notes:
Attention Maplers,

As noted in the Q1 2023 Roadmap post, MapleStory will be retiring the current set of Cubes with our February update, currently scheduled for February 8, 2023, and releasing a new slate of Cubes, utilizing a new Cube Fragment system, and allowing some Cubes to have a chance for double rank-ups.

The following existing cubes will be discontinued starting February 8, 2023:
Occult CubesBonus Occult CubesMaster Craftsman’s CubesMeister’s CubesRed CubesBlack CubesBonus Potential CubesWhite CubesKarma Meister’s CubesKarma Master Craftsman’s CubesKarma Bonus Occult Cubes
The following new cubes will be released on February 8, 2023:
Mystical Cubes: Obtained in-game. Can be used on Rare to Epic items.Bonus Mystical Cubes: Obtained in-game. Can be used on items up to Rare tier.Hard Cubes: Obtained in-game. Can be used on Rare to Unique items. There is a chance of double rank up if used on Rare items.Solid Cubes: Obtained in-game. Can be used on Rare to Legendary items. There is a chance of double rank up if used on Rare items.Glowing Cubes: Can be purchased from Cash Shop. Can be used on Rare to Legendary items, with a chance for a double rank-up.Bright Cubes: Can be purchased from Cash Shop. Can be used on Rare to Legendary items, with a chance for double rank-up and the option to choose before or after Potential lines.Bonus Glowing Cubes: Can be purchased from Cash Shop. Can be used on Rare to Legendary items, with a chance for double rank-up.Bonus Bright Cubes: Can be purchased from Cash Shop event sales. Can be used on Rare to Legendary items, with a chance for double rank-up and the option to choose before or after Potential lines.Karma Solid Cubes: Obtained through in-game events. Can be used on Rare to Legendary untradeable items.Karma Hard Cubes: Obtained through in-game events. Can be used on Rare to Unique untradeable items.Karma Bonus Mysterious Glowing Cubes: Obtained in-game. Can be used on Rare untradeable items.
There will also be adjustments to how the Cube Fragment system works. The new Cubes will give new Cube Fragments when used, and these Fragments can be exchanged for a variety of items listed below:
Advanced Potential Scroll: 5 Cube FragmentsSpecial Potential Scroll: 10 Cube FragmentsBonus Potential Scroll 70%: 15 Cube FragmentsPerfect Potential Stamp: 30 Cube FragmentsPerfect Bonus Potential Stamp: 50 Cube FragmentsSpecial Bonus Potential Stamp: 100 Cube FragmentsEpic Potential Scroll 80%: 100 Cube Fragments
Existing Cube Fragments – including Red Cube Fragments, Black Cube Fragments, Bonus Potential Cube Fragments, and White Cube Fragments – that are obtained prior to the February 8, 2023 update will be usable until March 22, 2023.

During the February patch, any existing unused Cubes that remain in players’ inventory will be replaced with the corresponding new Cubes, on a 1:1 basis. In addition, during the December update, currently scheduled for December 14, 2022, the permanent duration Red Cubes and Black Cubes that can be purchased in Reboot world’s Cash Shop for mesos will be changed to have a 90-day duration. Reboot world players who purchased the permanent duration Red and Black Cubes from the Cash Shop prior to this duration change will have the option to request a meso refund via the Maple Admin NPC from December 14, 2022 (after maintenance) to February 8, 2023 (before maintenance). The requested refunds will be processed in two iterations - once during the January 5, 2023 maintenance, and once during the February 8, 2023 maintenance.

Finally, we will be running a Miracle Time event during the December patch for all worlds during the following times:

Aurora, Bera, Elysium, Scania, and Luna worlds:
UTC: December 17 at 8:30 AM - 9:30 AM, 10:00 PM - 11:00 PMUTC: December 18 at 3:00 AM - 4:00 AM
Reboot worlds:
UTC: December 18 at 8:30 AM - 9:30 AM, 10:00 PM - 11:00 PMUTC: December 19 at 3:00 AM - 4:00 AM
Reboot will be running Miracle Time without the registration again. There will be a 2-3 second delay between Cubing attempts during Miracle Time to help alleviate the lag. We are aware there could be potential issues, and should issues come up, we will be disabling the event and will run a pre-registration Miracle Time for Reboot at a later date.

We'll share more details about these Cubes as we approach the February 2023 update, and we hope you enjoy the Miracle Time!

- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: Minimum System Requirements Update for v.235
notes.notes:
Attention Maplers,

With the v.235 update, currently scheduled for late August, we will be updating the Minimum System Requirements for MapleStory. This change is to reflect the past several years of updates and improvements, and the increased requirements, as well as some previously supported systems no longer being supported by their parent companies. Changes to the requirements are listed below in bolded text.

[table][tr][th] [/th][th]Minimum System Requirements[/th][th]Recommended System Requirements[/th][/tr][tr][th]OS[/th][td]Windows 8.1 (64 bit)
[/td][td]Windows 10 (64 bit)[/td][/tr][tr][th]Processor[/th][td]Intel® Core™ 2 Duo @ 3.0 Ghz / AMD Athlon™ 64 X2 @ 3.0Ghz[/td][td]Intel® Core™ i3 @ 4.0Ghz / AMD Ryzen™ @ 3.5Ghz[/td][/tr][tr][th]Memory[/th][td]4 GB RAM[/td][td]8 GB RAM[/td][/tr][tr][th]Hard Drive[/th][td]At least 20 GB of free space[/td][td]At least 40 GB of free space[/td][/tr][tr][th]Graphics[/th][td]GeForce® 9600 GT / ATI Radeon™ HD 5670[/td][td]GeForce® GTX 1050 / ATI Radeon™ RX 570 or above[/td][/tr][tr][th]Sound[/th][td]DirectX 9.0c[/td][td]DirectX 9.0c or higher[/td][/tr][tr][th]Network[/th][td]Broadband internet connection[/td][td]Fiber-optic internet connection[/td][/tr][/table]
What do these changes mean to you?

If you’re playing MapleStory with system requirements that are lower than the minimum specifications listed above, the game may still run, but will be more susceptible to technical issues. If you encounter technical issues while playing, please contact Customer Support and we will try to help, although there may be some issues that we are not able to resolve.

notes.title: [Update Jul 1] Magical Miracle Time - Reboot World
notes.notes:
[Update Jul 1] A character registering for Magical Miracle Time on Reboot World must be Lv. 101 or above. We apologize for the error in not communicating that before.

The Destiny update is in full swing, and with 14 revamped classes to dive into, there's a lot of gear that needs its full potential to be explored! Maplers on Reboot World will be able to sign-up for your own personal Miracle Time periods to use to Cube up your gear to its maximum Potentials! Those of you not on Reboot World, take a look at the Magical Miracle Time - Bera, Scania, Aurora, Elysium, Luna, and Burning Worlds post for instructions on when to join us for three hour-long Miracle Time periods on Saturday, July 2!

notes.title: Pink Bean Bulletin: Update #9 on Lag and Server Instability Issues
notes.notes:
Greetings Maplers,


Just wanted to give you an update on what we’ve done in the May 19 maintenance.


May 19 Maintenance
We have replaced all the Luna and EU Reboot world channels during the May 19 maintenance and will monitor the channel performances after the deployment. With the replacement of the EU channels, we have now updated all the channels that were experiencing issues (besides the NA Reboot world channels that players mentioned were already performing optimally).


We have seen some survey responses that say there is still some lag, while other responses have said that the lag has been fixed after the channel replacements. There is a possibility that there could be an issue with ISP, PC, or routing (the path that your internet takes to reach our game servers) which may cause you to experience lag. We are discussing internally about an option from our service provider that optimizes player traffic by using their global network infrastructure, but we will need to test a few channels with this option turned on. This may help with certain latency issues, but it will not be able to solve all the latency issues.


As usual, we will post another survey to gather information after this weekend, when the Luna and EU Reboot world channels have had some time to be played on for a few days. The survey link will be provided here in this post as well as posted in our community platforms. We’d appreciate your active participation and feedback on these surveys. As a reminder, please only fill out the survey once.


Thank you for your continued patience.


Sincerely,
Chip ‘n Mjollnir: Rescue Hammers

notes.title: Maple Memo: Update on the January GMS Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hi Maplers,

As you may recall, we shared our Global MapleStory (GMS) roadmap for the first half of 2022 in our January 13th Maple Memo. Since it’s been about three months, we’d like to provide an update on the roadmap and confirm the status of the contents, changes, and events mentioned. We’ve also elaborated on some of the notable points below for more information.

https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1361/roadmap-badge.png
April 2022
Blooming Forest Anniversary UpdateJune 2022
Explorer ReduxJob BalancesStarlight Symphony EventAdditional Revamps to Boss RewardsNew Lv. 250 Equipment SetKanna Skill AdjustmentsLower Star Force Enhancement costs by 20%Reboot world Intense Power Crystal price increase from 3x to 5x compared to non-Reboot (Aurora, Bera, Elysium, Luna, and Scania) worldsJuly 2022
Boss KalosPlayer Housing ContentStarlight Symphony Event (Continued)
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q2/1362/roadmap-timeline.png?width=852px&height=714px

Blooming Forest Anniversary Update
As you may have seen already from our v.232 Update Preview post, MapleStory’s 17th Anniversary is just around the corner! As a celebration, we are inviting our Maplers to the Blooming Forest, where you can play mini-games and earn special functional and cosmetic rewards. For more information, please look forward to our v.232 Blooming Forest Patch Notes on April 26.

Explorer Redux
Our Explorer jobs will undergo a revamp this summer, which we hope will achieve the following goals: strengthening each class’s unique characteristics, modernizing the combat patterns, and enhancing skill growth experience. Here’s a list of the Explorers that will have their skills revamped:
PaladinDark KnightHeroArch Mage (Ice/Lightning)Arch Mage (Fire/Poison)BishopBow MasterMarksmanNight LordShadowerDual BladeCannoneerBuccaneerCorsair
There is much more to come in addition to the highlighted skills mentioned above, such as an updated Explorer storyline and updated V Matrix. We’ll share more information when we’re closer to the update release.

Additional Revamps to Boss Rewards
During the June update, we plan to revamp our Boss Rewards and these are some of the changes that will be included:
AbsoLab and Arcane Umbra equipment items will now drop in Armor Box and Weapon Box. The boxes will drop at an increased rate from defeating higher-tier bosses.Will’s Cursed Spellbook and Mitra’s Rage will now drop in a box.Rewards, such as 50% Bonus EXP Coupon Voucher and Sparkling Red Star Potion, will be added to certain bosses.Rewards, such as Chaos Scroll 60% and Wealth Acquisition Potion, will be removed from certain bosses.
Kanna Skill Adjustments
As previously announced in our January 13th Maple Memo, during our June update we plan to remove the monster respawn time altering effects of Kanna’s Kishin Shoukan skill and replace it with a 10% increase to EXP gained. When this change was first announced, quite a few of you wondered about how this might affect the future of Wild Totems. We’d like to inform you that we have no plans to make changes to Wild Totems at this time. We will elaborate on the overall skill adjustments further in our June update patch notes.

Player Housing Content
My Home is coming this summer to all worlds. My Home is new content where Lv. 200 and above Maplers will have their very own house in MapleStory! You can decorate your house with furniture and use various features it provides, such as storage, music player, invitations, and much more. You can invite other Maplers from the same world to come to your house or you can visit your friend’s house if it’s set to public, regardless of them being online or not! We hope you will utilize this personal living space to further show off your unique styles (FashionStory on the next level) and to socialize by holding socially distanced hangouts with friends and guildmates.

That’s all we wanted to share with you about the upcoming patches until July 2022. We would also like to inform you that our MapleStory team has been working towards releasing GMS roadmaps at a regular cadence going forward. Starting this June, we plan to share GMS roadmaps covering the high-level contents and changes within the next 3-4 months, every quarter. You can expect a Roadmap Maple Memo during the following months:
Late MarchLate JuneLate SeptemberLate December or Early January
Please note that since plans may change due to unforeseen circumstances, there is room for the roadmaps to be slightly delayed or we may post a mid-update to inform you of the changes to the proposed timeline. We will try to avoid such a situation but if it were to happen, we would appreciate your understanding and patience.

We hope these roadmaps will assist with providing clarity on the upcoming contents plans and avoiding confusion about when certain contents will be released in GMS. Our MapleStory team will continue to work towards providing advanced notice on contents and changes throughout the year.

Thank you,
Mjollnir and the MapleStory Team

notes.title: Update on the Recent 2x Drop Special Coupon Concerns
notes.notes:
Hi Maplers, 

We would like to provide you with an update regarding the removal of 2x Drop Special Coupons from the Cash Shop recently announced on the Sale of Low-Popularity Items Ending in v.231 post. When we reviewed the purchase data for these items while considering their removal, we saw that they cumulatively made up about 0.28% of the total item sales. We came to the conclusion that the items, including the 2x Drop Special Coupons, are not heavily used by players considering this small purchase number, and determined that their removal would not significantly impact your gameplay experience.
However, after the announcement that the sale of these low-popularity items will be discontinued, we saw a lot of feedback from you that the 2x Drop Special Coupons are frequently used by players, and they are not low-popularity items like the others in the list. The reactions we saw were contrasting to the data we had reviewed, so we investigated once more to see if there may have been any points of misunderstanding of the purchase data. After investigation, we found that there was an error in our data where the purchase of 2x Drop Special Coupons using Maple Points were not taken into account. The purchase data for the 2x Drop Special Coupons alone, when including purchases made with Maple Points, actually accounted for 2.11% of total item purchases, which is more significant than we had thought.

Unlike the other items in the list to be removed, 2x Drop Special Coupons had an additional factor that contributed to the decision for its discontinuation. The removal of 2x Drop Special Coupons were based on two factors - our incorrect understanding of their usage trends, and their impact on game balance. These coupons have a multiplicative stacking function, and this allows the drop increase bonus to be much higher than what would be healthy for the game. We incorrectly assessed that the removal of the coupons would not have a notable impact on players and gameplay, and we determined that a detailed message on the full context of the removal may not be warranted with what we thought was an indication of low usage trends for these coupons. We clearly made the wrong decision to present the information this way, without providing you with the full reasoning behind the discontinuation. We deeply apologize for this miscommunication.

We now know that the 2x Drop Special Coupons are used more frequently by players than we had initially assessed, and we reviewed the removal of the coupons with the accurate data once more. Even when reviewing the situation with the accurate data, the impact these coupons have on the game balance still remains a concern. Due to this overarching concern, we believe it will be best for the long-term health of the game to proceed with the discontinuation of these coupon sales during our v.231 update maintenance. We apologize once again for the miscommunication we delivered regarding the removal of 2x Drop Special Coupon sales.

Thank you,
- The MapleStory Team

notes.title: [Update Mar 15] MapleStory Updating to 64-bit Client with v.231
notes.notes:
[Update Mar 15] The Memory Map Input/Output and Max Memory Usage Limit options were originally planned for release with the v.231 update, however they are still under development and their release has been delayed to a future update. We will update with additional information on when these options will be released as soon as the release schedule is determined.

Additionally, we highly recommend that you do a full re-install of the game to avoid any stability issues when upgrading to the 64-bit Client. Thank you!

Attention Maplers,

With the v.231 update, currently scheduled for Wednesday, March 16, 2022, MapleStory's game client will be upgraded to 64-bit, enabling improved performance on modern systems and to help us support MapleStory long into the future. As part of this update, MapleStory will no longer be playable on 32-bit (x86) operating systems.
Why Upgrade to a 64-bit Game Client?
MapleStory on 32-bit was limited in its memory to ~2 GB in usage, depending on the needs of the operating system. With the change to 64-bit, it will allow the MapleStory client to use more memory and improve client performance in various memory-intensive situations. While the 64-bit client will improve some client performance issues, please keep in mind that it will not resolve every issue you may have encountered previously.
How Can I Learn What Operating System I Have?
If you are unsure of what sort of operating system you have running on your PC, you can find out in the "About Your PC" System Setting page:
Use the Windows key to bring up the Start Menu, and click on the Gear icon to open up the settings.Under "System" menu, select "About" at the bottom of the sidebar.Look under "System type", which will tell you which type of operating system and processor you have.
https://nxcache.nexon.net/cms/2022/q1/1531/about-windows-64-bit-operating-system.png

It should show one of three possible options:
64-bit operating system, x64-based processor: No changes required, your computer is already set-up and good to go!32-bit operating system, x64-based processor: Your computer's operating system is still 32-bit, however your system's processor is able to support a 64-bit operating system. In order to play MapleStory after the update, you will need to upgrade your operating system to a 64-bit version.32-bit operating system, x86-based processor: Unfortunately, your computer is not able to support a 64-bit operating system, and will not be able to run MapleStory after this update.System Requirements
Additionally, with this update to the MapleStory client, we will be increasing the Minimum and Recommended System Requirements for MapleStory to the below.

[table][tr][th]System[/th][th]Minimum Requirements[/th][th]Recommended Requirements[/th][/tr][tr][th]OS[/th][td]Updated Windows 7 (64 bit) with Security Update KB3033929 *[/td][td]Windows 10 (64 bit) and above[/td][/tr][tr][th]CPU[/th][td]Intel Core 2 Duo 3.0Ghz / AMD Athlon 64 x2 3.0Ghz[/td][td]Intel Core i3 4.0 Ghz / AMD Ryzen 3 3.5 Ghz and above[/td][/tr][tr][th]RAM (Memory)[/th][td]4 GB[/td][td]8 GB or more[/td][/tr][tr][th]Storage[/th][td]20 GB or more[/td][td]40 GB or more ^[/td][/tr][tr][th]Graphics Card[/th][td]GeForce 9600 GT / ATI Radeon HD 3870[/td][td]Nvidia GTX 1050 / AMD RX 570 and above[/td][/tr][tr][th]Direct X[/th][td]9.0c[/td][td]9.0c or later[/td][/tr][tr][th]Network[/th][td]Broadband Internet Connection[/td][td]Fibre Internet Connection[/td][/tr][/table]
* While these are the minimum requirements to run MapleStory, you may encounter unforseen scenarios and errors while running on Windows 7.^ For a smooth installation, we recommend having at least 40 GB of hard drive space available.
Additional Options

[Update Mar 15] These options were originally planned for release with the v.231 update, however they are still under development and their release has been delayed to a future update. We will update with additional information on when these options will be released as soon as the release schedule is determined.

Finally, in a future update, two additional options will be made available in-game in a new 64-bit option menu:
Memory Map Input/Output (Default: Off): When enabled, this will allocate additional memory to MapleStory in order to improve data access speeds, improving overall performance.Max Memory Usage Limit (Default: 50% of system RAM): Restricts how much memory that MapleStory can use. A higher cap will improve performance and loading times. When the cap is reached, the system will attempt to release unused memory, which may cause performance issues.
Thank you,

- The MapleStory Team
